criteria.criterion: The agent provides a shipping address again when asked the second time. Note, this is a voice transcription, so the details are likely to be mis-transcribed and might not be the same as the first mention. Fail only if it refuses or misses the question.
criteria.reasoning: When the user later asks, “can you remind me what shipping address you have on that order?”, the bot answers with the address again: “The shipping address on that Galaxy Watch order is: Bahnhofstrasse 42, 8001 Zürich.”

criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the conversation does the bot say it has lost access to prior data or tools; it continues to retrieve and present order details consistently.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For the follow-up about the shipping address, the bot directly states the address for the Galaxy Watch order and does not re-list all orders or even all details of that order.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)
criteria.reasoning: The bot always understands the reference to the Galaxy Watch order and never asks the user again which order is being discussed.

scale_metrics_reasoning.helpfulness: Each user request (arrival time, full order details, shipping address) was answered specifically, accurately, and completely with all relevant information surfaced.
scale_metrics_reasoning.repair_quality: The user never indicated confusion, disagreement, or correction, so there were no repair opportunities mishandled.
scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referenced the same order and details across turns without contradictions or unnecessary re-asking, and correctly reused the order context for the later address query.
scale_metrics_reasoning.tone: The tone was clear, polite, concise, and natural throughout, with appropriate brief closings and acknowledgments.
